fusions.name: Wringing Squeeze
fusions.desc: A crushing grip that deals 9 damage, up to 1.2 times at maximum range. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Wrenching Hold
fusions.desc: A wrenching hold that deals 14 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rallying Grip
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds. You regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Unbroken Clasp
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
